entities.summary: Michelle C. Y. Chang is the A. Barton Hepburn Professor of Chemistry at Princeton University. She is the recipient of several young scientist awards for her research in biosynthesis of biofuels and pharmaceuticals. Previously, she was a Professor of Chemistry and Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering at the University of California, Berkeley, before moving her lab to Princeton in January 2024.
